guitar.modelsText: Gibson ES-355 / Les Paul / PRS / Hentor Sportscaster
guitar.evidence: Alex Lifeson's gear evolved a lot over Rush's career (Gibson ES-355 in early years, then Les Pauls, then signature PRS models); medium confidence is appropriate given the variety.

tone.target: bright synth-like chorus rock with tight crunch
tone.profile: bright synth-like chorus rock with tight crunch
tone.summary: Compression -> Chorus -> OD Boost -> UK 50 Amp -> UK Vintage 4x12. This setup provides the necessary synth texture, punchy articulation, and classic rock grit.
corrections: Keep chorus as the core texture
Lean more synth-like than generic rock
